messages:
Kevin Ng: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a 'deprecation beacon' (lightweight header + optional webhook) and a per-tenant compatibility lens in the gateway. Purpose: measurable retirements, reversible shims, lower support cost. Thoughts?

Maria Lopez: Beacon vs tombstone? how strict is the semantics?

Kevin Ng: Beacon = informational signal with metadata. semantics: clients SHOULD ack, servers SHOULD emit telemetry. Not binding until enforcement window elapses. Example header: `X-Deprecation-Beacon: api=v2; retire=2026-10-01; level=notice`

Samir Patel: OK. Need concrete gates: what metric and threshold moves us from notice -> soft limit -> hard 410?

Kevin Ng: Proposal: events: `deprecation.beacon_received`, `deprecation.ack`, `deprecation.rewrite_applied`. Gate: >=75% ack OR rewrite_applied <=5% over a 120d window to go hard. Soft-limit stage = 30d where we return 429 for non-ack clients.

Ashley Chen: UX: console must show per-tenant ack %, countdown, and a one-click extension for legal/compliance. Also surface top failing SDKs.

Kevin Ng: Admin API sketch: `PATCH /admin/deprecations/{tenant}` body: `extend_until`(ISO8601), `reason`, `enable_compat_lens`(bool). Compat lens defaults to observe-only and TTL 180d.

Maria Lopez: Telemetry target: label events with tenant, endpoint, api_version, and client_sdk so dashboards can filter. Also export per-tenant CSV weekly once beacon issued.

Samir Patel: About shims: prefer short declarative rewrites in gateway (param rename, field mapping). For heavier logic, run per-tenant adapter (sidecar) and mark requests with `X-Compat-Layer: true`. Gateway rewrites must be simple and auditable.

Kevin Ng: Agreed. Compat lens config will be declarative YAML, small mapping rules. Example snippet: ```yaml
compat_lens:
  mode: rewrite
  expires_at: 2026-12-01
  rules:
    - id: rename_user_id
      match_path: /v1/users
      map: { "userId": "id" }
```

Ashley Chen: Add auto-expire and an admin audit trail. If customers want long-term rewrites, require a support contract and explicit approval.

Samir Patel: Detection heuristics: if beacon_received >> ack and User-Agent matches our SDK list but ack is zero -> flag SDK regression. If User-Agent looks like CDN/proxy, suspect header stripping. Add a test to simulate header stripping in canary.

Kevin Ng: I'll include that test. For SDKs, simple ack snippet: `if (resp.headers['x-deprecation-beacon']) sendTelemetry('deprecation.ack')`.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: job id `canary-depbeacon-2026-09` queued for gateways -> eta ~20m

Maria Lopez: Please draft support playbook: how to interpret CSV, common rewrite rules, escalation for broken calls. That'll cut support tickets.

Kevin Ng: Will draft the full protocol doc, telemetry schema, admin API swagger, and compat-lens YAML spec. Will run canary on top-10 tenants then expand. Posting link when ready.

Ashley Chen: Ping me for console flow and the UX copy for countdown/extend.
